title: Qualify post-M7 Math local delivery evidence portfolio without publication
commitMessage: docs: qualify post-M7 Math delivery evidence portfolio without publication

contribution.summary: Qualify a source-pinned post-M7 Math delivery portfolio from the five existing RS124-RS128 durable reports. Reconcile the local thirteen-package roster, seven independent consumer executions, ninety-five numbered probes and separate quantity smoke, while preserving the exact first-pass history and public/external/ABI limits. No new build, package, product milestone or publication is attempted.
contribution.value: A standalone read-only BCL C# verifier checks five exact run outcomes (three first-pass YES and two NO), the real three pre-attempt refusals, fifteen source-pinned decision/matrix/validator SHA values, accepted roadmap v0.1.122, 541 done DWF nodes, qualified receipts and explicit negative publication/rights/Discovery/recipient claims. The payload stages only an English decision, distribution evidence matrix and checker, then writes one audited portfolio receipt. Stale README claims and actual historic consumer gaps remain documented instead of retroactively rewritten.
debtChanges: Thirteen Math preview packages were locally packed, not published. The observed net10 win-x64 environment is not a multi-RID support contract.
Seven independent consumer executions and 95 probes plus a quantity smoke do not mean universal Math API coverage or 47 current clients.
Public README still states the 2026-10-07 initial planning status; its historically source-pinned legacy checker requires a separate reconciled update.
Cross-version ABI, inherited rights, generated dw.discovery skill, advanced M7 providers and AURA/Decision/MCDM adoption remain unqualified.
No additional DWF progress is accepted: all 541 M0–M7 nodes remain done and no M8 or owner publication approval is implied.
contribution.nextAction: At successful RS129 completion, stop automatic audit expansion and request the owner's explicit next choice: release/rights gate, genuine pinned cross-version API/ABI, selected consumer rechecks, documentation remediation, Discovery, external owner coordination or a supported new roadmap.
